facts.text: I'd go easy on dinner tonight. The chicken looks safe, but I'm keeping an eye on anyone who ordered seafood.
facts.why: Not a Dr Rumack line. No quote page for the film was opened, and nothing in the plot sources matches. Rumack is the one who says 'I am serious. And don't call me Shirley.' (quoted on Wikipedia). Printed in quote marks and signed Dr Rumack.
facts.fix: I am serious. And don't call me Shirley.

facts.why: Wikipedia says passengers choose steak or fish. The menu dishes already say 'The steak, not the fish', so the ticket and Rumack note disagree with them.

facts.text: Fish or chicken, and why you chose wrong
facts.why: Same issue as the ticket line. The sources say the choice was steak or fish, and the fish caused the poisoning.
facts.fix: Steak or fish, and why you chose wrong

facts.text: Ted Striker's drink, mostly on his face.
facts.why: Ted splashes his drinks everywhere but his mouth, but no source names the drink, so 'Scotch and soda' is not confirmed.
facts.fix: Ted Striker's drinking problem, mostly down his front.
